_comment: Guides SkMate attaches by itself when a playlist is added or refreshed. Data, not code: a new provider is one more entry. 'providers' apply only when the playlist names no guide (url-tvg / x-tvg-url) of its own; 'hosts' are matched against the playlist URL's host and its parent domains. 'shared' guides are added for every playlist, after its own, so they only fill channels the own guide lacks; 'logos': true takes the channel logos from that guide. Checked 2026-10-28.
